verdict.stance: Overweight / Fortress Net-Cash South African PGM Major
verdict.summary: Implats staged a massive FY26 (Jun-26) rebound as PGM basket recovery and Royal Bafokeng integration lifted revenue 58% to ZAR 135.1bn and quadrupled EBITDA to ZAR 43.6bn, building ZAR 22.0bn in adjusted net cash against restrained ZAR 7.2bn capex.

positives: ZAR 22.0bn adjusted net cash buffer at FY26-end with disciplined ZAR 7.2bn capex.
Tier-1 Rustenburg, Zimplats, Marula, and Impala Canada/Bafokeng asset portfolio.
Strategic Materials market positioning in South Africa supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: High sensitivity to PGM basket prices (platinum, palladium, rhodium) and ZAR FX.
South African deep-level mining inflation, Eskom power tariff, and Zimbabwe royalty/FX risks.
Exposure to South Africa macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.
